verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege API credentials are a fair question for a payments API platform like Square, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers OAuth scopes, permission-limited access tokens, or restricted credentials. The MCP server, SDK, webhooks and sandbox items are about other capabilities and do not show credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
